```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,

)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

set.seed(1031)
```

## Synthetic spectra

```{r data}
gaussian_peak <- function(x, centre, width, amplitude) {
  amplitude * exp(-0.5 * ((x - centre) / width)^2)
}

wavenumber <- seq(300, 850, by = 0.7)

temperature_parameters <- tribble(
  ~temperature, ~offset, ~ao_amp, ~e2_amp, ~a1_amp, ~shoulder_amp, ~noise_sd,
  "450 °C", 0.36, 0.015, 0.020, 0.025, 0.012, 0.027,
  "525 °C", 1.30, 0.250, 0.095, 0.720, 0.190, 0.024,
  "550 °C", 2.45, 0.205, 0.245, 0.790, 0.170, 0.023
)

make_spectrum <- function(temperature, offset, ao_amp, e2_amp,
                          a1_amp, shoulder_amp, noise_sd) {
  baseline <- 0.025 * sin((wavenumber - 300) / 35) +
    0.012 * cos((wavenumber - 300) / 14)

  intensity <- offset + baseline +
    gaussian_peak(wavenumber, 421, 11, ao_amp) +
    gaussian_peak(wavenumber, 573, 23, e2_amp) +
    gaussian_peak(wavenumber, 729, 18, a1_amp) +
    gaussian_peak(wavenumber, 782, 29, shoulder_amp) +
    rnorm(length(wavenumber), 0, noise_sd)

  tibble(
    wavenumber = wavenumber,
    intensity = intensity,
    temperature = temperature
  )
}

spectra <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(temperature_parameters)), function(i) {
  do.call(make_spectrum, as.list(temperature_parameters[i, ]))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    temperature = factor(temperature, levels = c("550 °C", "525 °C", "450 °C"))
  )

write.csv(spectra, "synthetic_raman_spectra.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(temperature_parameters, "spectrum_parameters.csv", row.names = FALSE)

spectra
```

## Figure

```{r figure, fig.width=6.2, fig.height=10.5, out.width='72%'}
mode_bands <- tribble(
  ~xmin, ~xmax,
  407, 431,
  560, 585,
  716, 752
)

temperature_labels <- tribble(
  ~x, ~y, ~label,
  438, 3.02, "550 * degree*C",
  438, 1.90, "525 * degree*C",
  438, 0.72, "450 * degree*C"
)

p <- ggplot(spectra, aes(wavenumber, intensity, colour = temperature)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = mode_bands,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#D7D7D7",
    colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.88
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.35, lineend = "round") +
  geom_text(
    data = temperature_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5.0,
    colour = "#171717"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 419, y = 3.96, label = "AO", size = 5.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 572, y = 3.96, label = "E[2]*'(high)'", parse = TRUE, size = 5.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 734, y = 3.96, label = "A[1]*'(LO)'", parse = TRUE, size = 5.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "550 °C" = "#255DA8",
      "525 °C" = "#178DB8",
      "450 °C" = "#2BA9C1"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(300, 850),
    breaks = seq(300, 800, by = 100),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 4.10),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(Wavenumber~(cm^{-1})),
    y = "Intensity (a.u.)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(t = 12)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, colour = "#202020"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.65, colour = "#222222"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, colour = "#222222"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2.7, "mm"),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

ggsave(
  "raman_temperature_spectra.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 6.2,
  height = 10.5,
  dpi = 360,
  bg = "white"
)

p
```
